criteria.requirement: Implement werkzeug.negotiated_json.json_response(value,request,*,offers=("application/json",),status=200). Validate unique offered application/json or application/*+json media types, use actual request.accept_mimetypes.best_match for quality/specificity/wildcards, preserve offered order on ties and default first only when Accept is absent. Unacceptable including q=0 raises 406. Encode finite UTF8 JSON preserving false/null/Unicode, set selected Content-Type, exact length and Vary: Accept. Do not equate vendor JSON with plain JSON without an actual matching offer or silently emit a disallowed representation.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
